programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland

programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Time Bomb
programme.desc: In 1978, Lt. Joe Kenda is new to the CSPD, and gets more than he bargains for when a local bank is the target of a massive explosion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Body in the Freezer
programme.desc: A meeting between two businessmen leaves one shot in the face. Things seem cut and dry until Lt. Kenda realizes the “victim” could actually be the aggressor, shot struggling over his own gun.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Cage
programme.desc: Kenda finds the bullet-ridden bodies of a middle-aged couple in a musty suburban house alongside the corpses of their two beloved pets.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Primal Fear
programme.desc: A bloody shooting, steps away from a high school, leaves 14-year-old J.L. Jackson dead. Kenda uncovers a deadly vendetta stemming from a heated lunchroom confrontation.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: A park ranger discovers the corpse of amateur boxer Corey Edge floating in a shallow creek. Kenda learns the victim had ties to the criminal underworld, and investigates a rogue’s gallery of hustlers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: In 1992, Sylviane Kaas was found dead in her bedroom. Her husband had been the prime suspect for several years. Now exonerated, this murder remains unpunished.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal talks to DCI Clive Driscoll, to find out how his team uncovered a disturbing underworld of modern-day slavery and people trafficking, in an investigation sparked by murder.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal meets DCS Martin Brunning to discover how he cracked the shocking murder of Jolanta Dumciuviene, whose body was found wedged under the mattress of her own bed.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: July 2000, Vaucluse, a few kilometers from Avignon. Richard Alessandri, 42, a wealthy supermarket owner, is shot dead in his sleep. Everything suggests that it was a home-jacking gone wrong.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Strike
programme.desc: När Alice vägrar ge killarna ledigt för fejkhögtiden 'halvjul' bestämmer de sig för att strejka för bättre arbetsvillkor.

programme.title: Anthony Jeselnik - Caligula SV
programme.desc: Den mörka favoritprinsen av komedi, Anthony Jeselnik, låter äntligen pöbeln se hans ståupp. "Anthony Jeselnik: Caligula" filmades på Vic Theatre i Chicago och tar sig an ämnen som de flesta inte ens pratar högt om.

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.desc: 11 januari 2026 spelas handbollsmatchen Odense. Matchen kommenteras av sportkommentatorn Gustav Karlsson.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I ett anfall av sjuklig svartsjuka förgiftar den kompromisslösa och förföriska konstnären Ingrid sin älskare. Hon döms till livstids fängelse och hennes 15-åriga dotter Astrid får därefter flytta runt mellan olika fosterfamiljer.

programme.title: Boulevard: Boulevard
programme.desc: En tråkig bankman (Robin Williams) utmanas när han oväntat tar en ny riktning i livet och väljer kärleken.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerande berättelse om basketcoachen Ken Carter, som fick både kritik och beröm när han skapade rubriker efter att han bänkat hela sitt obesegrade lag på grund av deras dåliga studieresultat.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: Horrible Histories: The Movie - Rotten Romans
programme.desc: Baserad på BBC:s komediserie. Den romerske tonåringen Atti tvångsrekryteras till den romerska armén när en av hans smarta planer förargar kejsar Nero. Atti skickas till eländiga, kalla och regniga Britannien där barbarerna är upproriska.

programme.title: Death at a Funeral
programme.desc: En komisk vriden historia om en dysfunktionell familj som samlas för att sörja sin patriarks bortgång. Daniels far har just avlidit och det enda han vill är att genomföra begravningen som planerat, vilket inte är det lättaste med en galen familj på halsen

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones (Alyson Hannigan från American Pie-filmerna) letar länge efter den rättei helt fel filmer, ända tills hon äntligen lyckas roffa åt sig drömkillen!Nu börjar problemen.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom
programme.desc: Mary Jane ser fram emot en ångestfri helg men planerna går i stöpet när Mark ringer och ber henne om hjälp med hans föräldrar som är på besök. Avslöjanden under besöket tvingar Mark att göra en förändring.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best
programme.desc: Efter att Mary Janes affär har avslöjats tvingas hon inse att hon är mer intresserad än hon trott. Patricks fest för att fira nykterhet ger en bild av hur han en gång var.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sleepless In Atlanta
programme.desc: Kara försöker skydda Mary Jane från resultatet från en fokusgrupp, Niecy försöker skydda sig själv och Treyvion från hans far, som plötsligt återvänder från college. Patrick försöker balansera arbete och familj och Mary Jane träffar Sheldon.

programme.title: Boomerang: Don't Wanna Love You
programme.desc: Inflytandets makt prövar när influencern Tia får ett välbetalt gig på en strippklubb, och David påverkas av en ny megakyrka.

programme.title: Boomerang: Reversal Of a Dog
programme.desc: Bryson får inte upp den i sovrummet, och håller inte tillbaka när han pratar om det hos frisören. Ari funderar på sin sexualitet och maskulinitet, och utmanar sin självbild.

programme.title: Boomerang: Day Weekend
programme.desc: Simone samlar gänget och deras respektive vid sin pappas lyxiga strandhus. Syftet är att ena alla, men resultatet blir att allas förändring tydliggörs, och risken finns att de splittras.

programme.title: Twenties: Pilot The Pilot
programme.desc: Den blivande manusförfattaren Hattie blir vräkt och arbetslös, men så träffar hon den etablerade författaren och producenten Ida B, vars serie "Cocoa's Butter" Hattie har dissat i sociala medier.

programme.title: Twenties: I've Got The World On A String
programme.desc: Hattie försöker lära sig kontorspolitiken på sin första dag som assistent. Marie har bekymmer med sin spelande mamma, och Nia chansar på en dejt med sin yogakund.

programme.title: Twenties: Happy Place
programme.desc: Hattie letar förgäves sin 'lyckliga skrivplats'. Marie ställs mot studions enda andra svarta chef, och Nia ifrågasätter sitt karriärval.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2610
programme.desc: Jasmin drömmer om ett litet hus med en trädgård där hennes son kan springa runt och leka. Men hon vill också visa omvärlden att hon har kontroll över sitt liv, som just nu finansieras av olika lån.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Jonna och Thomas bor i Holeby på Lolland med sina barn. Thomas har en miljonskuld från sitt förflutna som de måste ta itu med.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2607
programme.desc: Christina, som bor i Allested-Vejle på Fyn, äventyrar sina relationer, hälsa och ekonomi. Hon arbetar 80 timmar i veckan men klarar ändå inte av att spara eller betala sina räkningar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Anne och Ali älskar att vårda sin relation genom att gå ut och äta på restaurang. Något som de gör ofta. Om Anne och Ali ska kunna uppfylla sin dröm om att äga sitt eget hem måste de dra ner på lyxen och öka det sunda förnuftet.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 3004
programme.desc: Sarah och Christian hyr istället för att bo i Christians hus. Det beror på att huset väcker Christians PTSD. Paret oroar sig mycket, gör inget åt sin situation. Kan de ändra sina vanor?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2902
programme.desc: Ulla och Jan bor i Kjellerup. Paret har svårt att betala sina räkningar och försökte nyligen låna pengar från en bank som de hade sett annonseras på Facebook - men det visade sig vara en bluff.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Vit singelsyster
programme.desc: När Janes vilda yngre syster, Sydney, kommer till stan för ett överraskande besök, går hon genast Jane på nerverna.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Jordnötssmör och svartsjuka
programme.desc: Jos ex-make, Charles, dyker upp och försöker övertyga henne om att han slutat dricka, men Jake har svårt att hålla sig borta när Charles är där.

programme.title: Melrose Place: En operfekt bild
programme.desc: När Alison befordras från receptionist till kontoansvarig, anlitar hon Jo för att fotografera underkläder.

programme.title: Melrose Place: En för mycket
programme.desc: Amanda bjuder in Alison och Billy till hennes fars sommarstuga, där hon och Billy genast blir attraherade av varann.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Min nya partner
programme.desc: Alison fortsätter vara svartsjuk över att Billy träffar Amanda, tills hennes gamla pojkvän Keith, som nu är frånskild, plötsligt dyker upp och ber henne återförsonas.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Farväl Billy
programme.desc: Alison söker mentalt stöd från Keith när hon under vapenhot blivit rånad på hans bil. Amanda presenterar Billy för sin far.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Rachel kanske kan hjälpa Martin att förändra sig. Louisas återvändo gör att relationsfrågor mellan henne och Martin uppstår.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: Martin bestämmer sig för att flytta från kirurgin för att ge Louisa det utrymme hon behöver. Louisa blir lite fascinerad av att träffa Martin teapeut vilket snabbt avtar när Rachel föreslår parterapi.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: Louisa och Martin har sin första terapisession tillsammans och ingen av dem var förberedda på att det skulle få hemläxa.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Martin når en brytpunkt och Louisa och Morwenna övertalar Martin att hitta ett nytt hem åt Buddy. Martin är inte särskillt imponerad över Angelas alternativa tillvägagångssätt till medicin.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 706
programme.desc: Dr. Timoney råder Martin och Louisa att gå tillbaka och minnas hur deras relation var i början och planera en dejt. Danny, Louisas ex, kommer från London tillsammans med 7 barn.

programme.title: Wildfire: You Can't Count On Me
programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.title: Wildfire: Picking Sides
programme.desc: Kris tries to repair the rift between Matt and Junior, but the tension is exacerbated by the approach of the important Bristol Stakes and the return of Gillian, who proceeds to resume her bonding with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: So Long, Pardner
programme.desc: In the third-season finale, Kris and Matt weigh a generous offer from Sheik Omar that would go a long way toward easing Raintree's financial woes---but that also may be against the law.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 1
programme.desc: The fourth season begins six months after Kris was forced out of Raintree, which has undergone significant operational changes that leave Matt pining for the past.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 2
programme.desc: After Kris unexpectedly returns for a glimpse of Wildfire's next race, she gains an unlikely ally and a place to stay.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: För att lindra sina ekonomiska problem söker en anställd på en resebyrå efter ett fruset lik, som råkar vara eftertraktat av två mördare.

programme.title: Picture of Lies: Picture of Lies
programme.desc: Konstkritikern James och hans flickvän Berenice reser till konstsamlaren Cassidys överdådiga palats vid Comosjön. Konstsamlaren har en ovanlig begäran till paret: de ska stjäla en målning.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: Två rivaliserande fastighetsmäklare tvingas samarbeta för att sälja ett speciellt hus, ägt av en känd botaniker och mistelodlare, före jul.

programme.title: Much Ado About Christmas
programme.desc: Efter att Haley Lloyd har blivit sviken av otaliga friare är det uppfriskande när den blyge men stilige Claud faller för henne, ovetandes om hennes sanna identitet.

programme.title: Candy Coated Christmas
programme.desc: En ung kvinna återvänder till sin mors hemstad Peppermint Hollow efter att hennes planer på att starta ett företag har gått i stöpet.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En kommunchef tar hjälp av en barndomsvän för att arrangera stadens välgörenhetsevenemang, samtidigt som hon parar ihop honom med sin väninna.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Vad kan vara konstigare än att ett stort hål öppnar sig i Lucy Sherringtons vardagsrumsgolv? Jo, kärleken, som det visar sig.

programme.title: Love at Mariposa Beach
programme.desc: En kvinna som brottas med problem på sin arbetsplats tar ledigt för att besöka sin mor. På resan till hemstaden reflekterar hon över livet vilket leder henne till kärleken.

programme.title: Paterson
programme.desc: Paterson (Adam Driver) är busschaufför i staden Paterson, New Jersey. Varje dag kör han sin dagliga rutt under vilken han observerar staden när den flimrar förbi genom vindrutan och lyssnar samtidigt på fragment av passagerarnas konversationer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Steel
programme.desc: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Switch
programme.desc: After Johnny boards a train for some much-needed relaxation, he has a vision of a woman thrown to her death and soon falls for the intriguing beauty.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Game of Pool
programme.desc: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programme.desc: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
programme.desc: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programme.desc: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: The Mountain
programme.desc: After Johnny is struck by the vision of a plane lost in a crash, thieves in search of a missing treasure take Johnny, Sara, Walt and J.J. hostage.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Faire Is Foul
programme.desc: På Sylvesters födelsedag besöker team Scorpion en renässansfestival, men festligheterna avbryts när en grupp försöker råna ett närliggande bevisförvaringsskåp hos polisen.

programme.title: Scorpion SV: It's Raining Men (of War)
programme.desc: På Thanksgiving följer team Scorpions nya granne Florence med till sjöss på ett uppdrag att förstöra en flytande ö bestående av skräp.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: End of Days
programme.desc: The discovery of a family home littered with corpses tasks Kenda with unspooling the paranoid obsessions of a diseased mind, and forces him to confront his greatest fear.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Follow the Money
programme.desc: The body of a 72-year-old man is found in a junkyard, stabbed 13 times and wearing nothing but his underwear and dentures.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: No Good Deed
programme.desc: After a man is brutally gunned down in the middle of the street, Kenda must piece together a complicated puzzle of conflicting stories and dead ends.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Too Young To Die
programme.desc: A frenzied ambush at a hamburger stand leaves a 16-year old boy dead. Lt. Joe Kenda must cut through a mountain of rumor and innuendo in order to zero in on his prime suspect.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: July 2000, Vaucluse, a few kilometers from Avignon. Richard Alessandri, 42, a wealthy supermarket owner, is shot dead in his sleep. Everything suggests that it was a home-jacking gone wrong.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre meets former DI Simon Shuttleworth to discover how Leicester Police captured the murderers of 45-year-old Timothy Smith, found fatally wounded in a crashed car.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal meets former Met Detective Inspector Tony Bishop to discover how the fatal poisoning of Lakhvinder Lucky Cheema was solved.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Renowned journalist Donal MacIntyre meets Detective Inspector Jim Hodgson of Lincolnshire Police to find out how he and the murder squad solved the brutal killing of Marina Erte.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Palm Beach
programme.desc: In 2009, Mike Dippolito was found shot in his Palm Beach home. Suddenly his wife, Dalia, became a trophy widow. Only a surprise confession would reveal the bizarre truth about Mike’s murder.

programme.desc: Kyles adopterade bror Ike hämtas tillbaka till Kanada av hans biologiska föräldrar eftersom den nya kanadensiska premiärministern har bestämt att alla barn som adopterats från Kanada måste lämnas tillbaka.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerande berättelse om basketcoachen Ken Carter, som fick både kritik och beröm när han skapade rubriker efter att han bänkat hela sitt obesegrade lag på grund av deras dåliga studieresultat.

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin och Les föder upp prisvinnande får på varsin farm i ett litet australiensiskt samhälle.När en sjukdom sprider sig bland djuren och myndigheterna bestämmer att samtliga får i dalen ska avlivas, måste männen samarbeta för att rädda sitt levebröd.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: Medan den singelmamma Grace försöker balansera arbete, räkningar och sin affär med en gift läkare, planerar hennes dotter Ansiedad en genväg till vuxenlivet efter att ha hittat inspiration i de coming-of-age-berättelser hon läser i skolan.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the drug trade in New York City was a nightmare. Dealers made millions. Street violence was out of control. The NYPD battled the drug gangs only to become their target.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones (Alyson Hannigan från American Pie-filmerna) letar länge efter den rättei helt fel filmer, ända tills hon äntligen lyckas roffa åt sig drömkillen!Nu börjar problemen.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead
programme.desc: Donald bor sedan 17 år i ett självbyggt kyffe i parken Hampstead Heath i London. När det ska byggas lyxbostäder där han bor vägrar han att flytta. Han får då oväntad hjälp av den amerikanska änkan Emily och en djup vänskap uppstår mellan dem.

programme.title: Twenties: Happy Place
programme.desc: Hattie letar förgäves sin 'lyckliga skrivplats'. Marie ställs mot studions enda andra svarta chef, och Nia ifrågasätter sitt karriärval.

programme.title: Twenties: You Know How I Like It
programme.desc: Hattie har tiden emot sig när hon ilar genom Hollywood på olika uppdrag från Ida B. Nia kämpar med en audition.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: No Eggspectations
programme.desc: Kara föreslår ett livesänt inslag i "Talk Back" men varken hon eller Mary Jane är beredda på det dr Marrs ska berätta och att Cameron är tillbaka i Niecys liv blir en källa till diskussion.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Pulling The Trigger
programme.desc: Mary Janes hormoner slår bakut efter en hormonspruta som påbörjar en nedräkning på 36 timmar till ägglossning. Hon får också erbjudande om en exklusiv story av Sheldon DeWitt, och relationen med Lisa blir alltmer ansträngd.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Let's Go Crazy
programme.desc: Mary Jane blir förtvivlad när hon får veta att att en av hennes intervjuer har lett till att den som intervjuats tagit sitt liv. SNC:s reaktion är att stoppa Talk Back, vilken gör att Mark hamnar i en knivig sits.

programme.title: Boomerang: Hot Sex
programme.desc: Crystal åker till Paris för att fira sitt nya jobb. Först är hon mest intresserad av sociala medier, men utan mobil hittar hon äventyr och romantik, och blir en ny, sexig, stark och självständig Crystal, inte definierad av sina vänner.

programme.title: Boomerang: Feels Like Heaven
programme.desc: Efter sju dagar religiös fasta hamnar David i ett drömlikt tillstånd där han följer hjältens resa för att hitta Gud, och kanske hitta de svar han är ute efter.

programme.title: Boomerang: End of the Road
programme.desc: När vi lämnar säsongen umgås gänget. Men vid en närmare titt är de kanske inte som förut. De kanske verkligen har växt isär.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2902

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Happy Gay Day!

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: Forensic Files: True Lies
programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Too Young To Die
programme.desc: A frenzied ambush at a hamburger stand leaves a 16-year old boy dead. Lt. Joe Kenda must cut through a mountain of rumor and innuendo in order to zero in on his prime suspect.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: City Of Fear
programme.desc: When a spate of violent robberies spreads terror across the city, Kenda and the major crimes unit are called in to bring the masked gunman to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Night Terrors
programme.desc: When Cheryl Brantner’s children find her dead in her bathtub, Lt. Joe Kenda must decide if this was a soapy accident or something worse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: I Will Hunt You Down
programme.desc: When two escaped inmates surface in Colorado Springs, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda and his Fugitive Unit to bring them to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rest In Peace
programme.desc: When an Air Force veteran dies unexpectedly, Kenda and his team must determine if it was a tragic accident or premeditated murder.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Palm Beach
programme.desc: In 2009, Mike Dippolito was found shot in his Palm Beach home. Suddenly his wife, Dalia, became a trophy widow. Only a surprise confession would reveal the bizarre truth about Mike’s murder.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana försöker tjäna lite extrapengar i 'temp game'. Abbi lovar sin granne att vänta in hans paket, men när hon missar leveransen måste hon ta sig till världens ände för att hitta det.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: När Abbi sanerar sin lägenhet mot ohyra och Ilana tappar bort sina nycklar tvingas tjejerna att bo på gatan - just när Abbi har sin första konstutställning.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Tjejerna måste växa upp! Abbi vill köpa sin egen marijuana, som en vuxen kvinna, medan Ilana måste tackla skatten på egen hand. Och, tjejerna är höga som hus.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: När Abbi förstår att hon är för snäll, ser hon till att bli mer bitchig. Ilana beslutar sig för att nå sin fulla potential. De går på ett exklusivt party och träffar några äventyrliga dj:ar. Nu kan inget gå fel.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana rider ut en kommande storm med Jaimé, Lincoln och Jeremy. Tyvärr får de också sällskap av Bevers och hans syster. De spelar 'Who Done It?' medan stormen rasar utanför.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana letar febrilt efter en sista-minutenpresent till Lincoln medan Abbi försöker att hitta en luftkonditionering för att få det svalt i sovrummet.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Det dyker upp nya möjligheter när Abbi äntligen lyckas att träna någon på Soulstice och Ilana gör succé som företagshöjdare.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi måste dra ut sina visdomständer och Ilana ser det som sin plikt att sköta om henne tills hon mår bättre - vilket självklart innebär en massa 'medikamenter' och en påtaglig brist på tillsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi och Jeremy går på en dejt som slutar med en överraskning medan Ilana och hennes mamma letar överallt efter den perfekta handväskan.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Tjejerna letar efter den perfekta festen, vilket avslöjar en underlig och surrealistisk sida hos Abbi som bekräftar Ilanas värsta farhågor.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Gänget ska fira att Jaime blivit amerikansk medborgare men Bevers leder Abbi och Ilana på avvägar genom att lova dem gratissprit. Under tiden får Lincoln och Jaime klara sig själva bland alla advokater.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Affair Trade
programme.desc: Doug får panik när han får sexiga telefonmeddelanden som är ämnade för en annan Doug Heffernan, men Carrie verkar inte bry sig. Danny försöker skapa en klyfta mellan Spence och hans nya dambekant.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Major Disturbance
programme.desc: Familjen Palmers semesterplaner går om intet när Doug skrämmer Major så till den grad att han vägrar bli passad av paret Heffernan.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Moxie Moron
programme.desc: Doug och Deacon vikarierar för arbetsledare O'Boyle på IPS. Carrie ångrar att hon under ett viktigt projekt klagade på sitt företags smaklösa gåva.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Ruff Goin'
programme.desc: Doug känner sig sårad för att han inte blev inbjuden till kvartersfesten och adopterar en hund för att bevisa att han är en schysst kille. Under tiden faller Arthur offer för ett spelberoende när han försöker hjälpa Danny att bli av med det.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Brace Yourself
programme.desc: En osmickrande bild på Major får Arthur att be Doug och Carrie om tandställning. Samtidigt anlitar Kelly den arbetslöse Spence till att hjälpa till i hemmet.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Home Cheapo
programme.desc: Carrie är övertygad om att Deacon och Kelly bara hade råd med sitt semesterhus eftersom de snålat. Samtidigt försöker Arthur hjälpa Spence att få nytt jobb.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Offensive Fowl
programme.desc: Carrie tröttnar på att Doug tvingar på henne sin nya vegetariska livsstil. Dessutom vill Carries chef diskutera romaner och Spence tackar ja till ett förödmjukande jobb.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Mild Bunch
programme.desc: På Dougs 20-åriga klassträff kommer en gammal vän på ett sätt att ge igen på deras rektor för gammalt groll. Danny och Spence försöker få till det med gamla klasskamrater. Carrie och Arthur försöker ha en filmkväll tillsammans.

programme.title: The King of Queens SV: Manhattan Project

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey

programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rest In Peace

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Justified

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Setup

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: River of Blood

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: I Now Pronounce You Dead

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Down for the Count

programme.title: Very Scary People: Son of Sam: I Am A Monster (Part 2)

programme.title: Very Scary People: BTK: Bind, Torture, Kill (Part 1)

programme.title: Very Scary People: BTK: The Taunting (Part 2)

programme.title: On the Case: Over The Edge

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Mr. LA

programme.desc: Carly får betyget B på en historieuppsats hon borde ha fått ett A på. Sam ser sin chans under sitt veckomöte med rektor Franklin, och ändrar Carlys betyg i datorn och överraskar henne med flera A.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly räddar TV
programme.desc: En höjdar-producent vill förvandla iCarly till en TV-show. Men Carly, Sam och Freddie blir snabbt upprörda när de får höra talas om alla de stora ändringar som TV-producenten vill göra.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag hatar Sams pojkvän
programme.desc: Sam skaffar pojkvän, och de båda är oskiljaktiga. Men när förhållandet börjar påverka iCarly, inser Carly och Freddie att de måste göra något åt det.

programme.title: iCarly: Övervakning
programme.desc: Efter att ha sett ett inslag på iCarly som visade en man som säljer olagliga filmkopior, bestämmer sig två poliser för att använda Carlys och Spencers våning som en övervakningsplats.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag kanske byter skola
programme.desc: Carly får veta att hon på grund av sin webbshow, kan få möjlighet till ett heltäckande stipendium till den privata elitskolan Briarwood. Carly är inte så sugen på det, men Sam och Freddie vet att de måste få henne att ändra sig.

programme.title: iCarly: Fart och fäkt
programme.desc: Freddie behöver spendera tid med bara killar, så han följer med Spencer på fäktning. Freddie är en naturbegåvning, men saker och ting blir komplicerade när Spencer får honom involverad i en match mot den fantastiske Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en dejt
programme.desc: När deras vän Gibby är för blyg för att bjuda ut en tjej han gillar, bestämmer sig gänget för att göra honom och föremålet för hans kärlek till tävlande i ett "Vinn en dejt"-inslag i sin webbshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag såg honom först
programme.desc: När Carly och Sam blir intresserade av samma kille, lovar de att det inte ska komma emellan deras vänskap. Det här visar sig bli svårare än de trott och snart prövas deras vänskap medan de håller på och tävlar om hans uppmärksamhet.

programme.title: iCarly: Beroendeframkallande
programme.desc: Carly måste ingripa när Spencer blir spelberoende. Sam lurar Freddie att tro att han har drabbats av otur bara för att han vägrade skicka vidare ett kedje-email.

programme.title: iCarly: Lånet
programme.desc: Sam blir förolämpad när Freddie anklagar henne för att inte betala tillbaka pengarna hon ständigt lånar av honom och Carly. Sam försöker allt hon kan komma på för att kunna betala tillbaka; till och med ett riktigt jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Aj, Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Driva med Lewbert"-sketch går förskräckligt fel och skadar Carlys oförskämde portvakt. Gänget vårdar honom tills dess att Freddies mamma kommer in och tar över. När en romans börjar spira måste de sätta stopp för den.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: The Western Allies secure supply routes that will allow them to enter Germany, and the Ardennes counter-offensive fails. The Red Army advances rapidly. The SS implements the Holocaust.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman undertakes an investigation of her own. In her mother's diary, she discovers a dark family secret that might explain the disappearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cries Unheard
programme.desc: A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car; the scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Worst I’ve Ever Seen
programme.desc: Two grandparents are shot to death in their family home. Kenda’s investigation kicks into high gear when his prime suspect flees for the Mexican border.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Winter’s Bone
programme.desc: High in the mountains above Colorado Springs, a woman’s frozen body is found along a switchback road. Investigators need to figure out what brought her here in the first place.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Clare Wood
programme.desc: In April 2007, Clare Wood met George Appleton on a dating website and they embarked on a relationship together. Unbeknownst to her, Appleton was a criminal with a severe history of violence against women.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Philpotts
programme.desc: When six children died in a house fire in Allenton, Derby in May 2012 it shocked the nation. Parents Mick and Mairead Philpott were charged with the murders. We uncover the reasons behind the arson attack on their own home.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Renowned crime journalist and Criminologist Donal MacIntyre meets Detective Chief Inspector Andy Guy from Suffolk and Norfolk Major Investigation Team, to discover how he solved the extraordinary double murder of Peter and Sylvia Stuart.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews former Metropolitan Police Detective Chief Inspector Sue Hill to find out how she and her team cracked the murder of lawyer Tom ap Rhys Pryce.

programme.title: iCarly: Pajen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Spencer tar med Freddie till sin favorit-pajställe, får de veta att ägaren har avlidit. Ännu värre; det verkar som om hans recept har gått förlorade för alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: En normal jul
programme.desc: I ett försök att krydda julfirandet med en ovanlig julgran, råkar Spencer av misstag sätta eld på alla Carlys julklappar. Ursinnigt önskar hon att hon hade en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen
programme.desc: Sam råkar höra när Freddie erkänner för Carly att han aldrig har kysst en tjej , och avslöjar sedan hans hemlighet på webbshowen. Gibby och Carly tränar Spencer inför uttagningen till det lokala proffs-fotbollslaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil
programme.desc: Gänget kör en tävling på iCarly; priset är en ny bil tack vare en lokal bilfirma. Efter att Nevel vunnit, upptäcker ungdomarna att bilfirman inte kände till tävlingen eller gratis-bilen som de påstods ha donerat till tävlingen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sluta Fred
programme.desc: Freddie säger under en sändning att han inte är ett fan av internetsensationen Fred, vilket får Fred att meddela att han tänker sluta att lägga ut filmer för alltid. Fansen blir rasande för att Freddie har orsakat slutet för de populära filmerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Dubbelgångare
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie smiter ut för att se en kampsport-match, skaffar de dubbelgångare för att lura Spencer att de fortfarande är hemma. Under tiden bygger Spencer en gigantisk version av Newtons vagga.

programme.title: iCarly: Rockidolen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie uppmanar iCarly-fansen att rösta för att David Archuleta ska ta hem segern i "America Sings", tycker de synd om tvåan och hjälper honom göra en musikvideo. Under tiden lär Sam Spencer hur man ljuger som ett proffs.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Makeover
programme.desc: När Sam erkänner att hon är kär i en kille i skolan, visar Carly hur hon kan locka honom genom att bete sig mer tjejigt. Under tiden blir Spencer övertygad om att en tjej gillar honom på grund av hans smoking, så han börjar ha den på sig hela tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 1
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.
